import { html, svg } from 'lit';

export const localized = html`<button aria-label=${t('close')} title="${t('close')}">${t('save')}</button>`;

export const symbols = html`<span>${count}</span><span>12 / 34 &times; 5</span><!-- a comment with words -->`;

export const icon = svg`<path d="M0 0h24v24H0z" />`;

// visible-string: a URL scheme, not language
export const marked = html`<input placeholder="https://" />`;

export const hole = html`<input placeholder="https://" ${/* visible-string: a URL scheme */ ''} />`;

export const sameLine = html`<code>npm i</code>`; // visible-string: a command
